We've now covered every part of your original goal. Let me do a quick **summary check** before we go deeper.

So far these five behaviours are settled and working together on one screen:

1. **Save a link fast** — the title fills in by itself and you can edit it, plus an optional "why I saved this" note.
2. **Organise with tags** — type-and-Enter tag chips; click a tag to narrow the list.
3. **Search** — one box that looks across title, note, tags and address; multiple words narrow further; works within a tag filter.
4. **Track what's still to read** — a "to read" default, a badge, All / To read / Read views with a counter, and a read/unread toggle.
5. **Safety-net copy** — opt-in per important link; the normal link still opens the original, and a kept copy stays viewable inside the app.

**Do all of these behaviours, as you experienced them, match your intent?** If yes, I'll move on to walk you through the "what happens when…" situations (an empty app, very long lists, a bad link address, and so on) before we consider building the real thing.
